reviews.text: Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. We’re delighted to receive your 5-star rating, Fred!

I think I actually saw him smile last night. Dr. Daniella gave him the best treatment. She expelled his anal gland and honestly I think that may have been really bothering him. That's him all relaxed in the picture after his treatment. Thanks Dr. Daniella.

Our puppy’s first wellness visit was great!  The front desk staff were friendly and very helpful!   Our vet was professional, kind and informative on our new puppy, next vaccines and what to expect during next few months.  We are very pleased to start Kiki’s life with us with such great support from McGilvary.
Always the best care and service! But prices are very high, particularly in the last couple of years.

When I brought my older pug there for the first time Dr. Fleming went above and beyond to try to sort out what was wrong with her and get her feeling better. Very grateful for this place. Highly recommended

This is the best veterinary hospital in Toronto.  I have been a client for over 30 years, starting with my first dog when I was 17.  Dr. Darren Marks and his team are genuinely caring, exceptionally skilled, and always go above and beyond to help you and your pet whether it is an after hours emergency or a routine visit.  My dogs are my world and the team at McGilvray’s understands this special bond and manages to combine state of the art treatment and preventative medicine with real compassion and sensitivity.  I give them the highest recommendation without qualification.  Now they are offerng behaviorist appointments with Caryn which is a terrific addition for us!!

We have used McGilvray for vet services for many years on a variety of pets. Their care has always been compassionate and effective. In addition, they have helped us find two pets for adoption. They are always available on short notice for serious concerns, even during the recent covid shutdowns. Highly recommended.

Our cat Marfusha, needed dental surgery and we were looking for the right place to have it done. We found McGilvray Clinic and Dr. Lee, and it was a perfect match.

Dr. Lee was incredibly attentive and took the time to explain everything about Marfusha’s condition and the upcoming surgery. The surgery went very well, and he kept us updated throughout the entire day, provided us with detailed aftercare instructions and followed up with us the next day.

Even tho the whole experience was very stressful for us, Dr. Lee did everything he could to make sure both our cats and we, as their owners, felt comfortable and supported throughout the process.

I also want to give a special thank you to the front desk team for their coordination, kindness, and support.

Thank you so much to the entire McGilvray team for all your hard work and care! ❤️
Very kind staff and Dr Lee was pacient.

I'm always confident that Odis is getting the best care from McGilvray whether it’s a medical or grooming appointment. My most recent appointment with Dr. Marks conformed to my schedule and eased my mind with a health issue!
Your feedback is incredibly valuable. Thank you for sharing your experience with McGilvray Veterinary Hospital.
Superb, highly professional, kind, amazing experience!
Friendly and caring. Professional and clean environment.
Kind responsive staff and Dr Booth is a wonderful vet.
Excellent Veterinary practice
Very friendly environment. My dog’s first time visit and no signs of stress from her.
Dr. Lee was great to Mochi our dog. We just got Mochi and are so grateful we found his doctor for the rest of his life. The staff at McGilvray are also quite kind and trustworthy.

Thank you McGilvary Team and to my favorite Vet Dr. Kyle Lee for helping me get through this difficult time.  Taylor loved you all and even at 19yrs young he would still get those zoomies! Much gratitude and love.  ***** ROCK STARS!  *****    Kelly
Wonderful staff, very accommodating to my sweet girl Parker who struggles with fear aggression. 😬🙏 …
Special thanks to Dr. Hadi and Nara🙏 …

McGilvray Veterinary is not only a fabulous animal hospital but they also do amazing grooming. Our toy poodle is 9 years old and loves going to be groomed. He can hardly wait to jump out of the car and into the arms of whoever they send to take him from me. He loves the people and is never in a hurry to come home. I would recommend McGilvray to anyone who has a pet.

This is my new dog Buddy who is now a new patient at McGilvray. I still find them to be excellent and very caring. I trust them completely.
Thank you for sharing your concerns. We appreciate your feedback.
We're glad to hear about your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Always friendly and helpful!

Almost every time they send my dog's prescription to my preferred pharmacy there's some sort of mistake.

This, on top of the fact that they are very slow in communicating with myself or the pharmacy.

It probably has to do with the fact that they would rather me just purchase the medications from them for 3x what other pharmacies charge.
Dr. Daniella was kind, professional and patient. I knew my dog was in great hands. I will be recommending her to my family and friends!

We had such a wonderful experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital! We brought our dog, Brownie, in for his vaccinations, and from the moment we walked through the door, everyone made us feel so welcome.

The reception staff, technicians, and veterinarians were all incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely caring. They treated Brownie with so much patience, love, and compassion that he felt comfortable throughout the entire visit.

It’s clear that the team truly loves animals and is passionate about providing the highest level of care. Thank you for making what could have been a stressful visit such a positive experience. We are so grateful and highly recommend McGilvray Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

I have been taking my dogs to McGilvray Veterinary Hospital for many, many years.  The care and attention given to my pets are second to none!  I would never take them anywhere else and I highly recommend McGilvray Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for the best!  Thank you McGilvray!

Exceptional care from all the staff at McGilvray. Dr Marks has always taken great care of all our pets (14 years!)including our new puppy, with great tips and guidance. We take great comfort in knowing our pets have such great care throughout their lives.

Delete this They killed my cat !!
—————————————————-
Very caring for my sick BennieBoy with tooth problem. I am so glad I switched over to them because my cat is my love of my life.

I can’t recommend McGilvray Veterinary Hospital enough. The entire team is incredibly kind, compassionate, and genuinely cares about both their patients and their owners. They always take the time to listen to every concern I have—no matter how big or small—and never make me feel rushed or dismissed. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and genuine love for animals give me complete confidence that my dogs are receiving the best possible care. It’s such a relief knowing they’re in such caring hands. Thank you to everyone at McGilvray for everything you do!
My little guy is treated which such great care and I love our doctor she’s amazing !!

Bailey is always anxious when she visits and this time was a new vet Dr John.   Everything went well except she needs to lose some weight or she will have health issues. We understand.
Only negative is vet pricing is always too high

We had concerns with our very spicy kitty and the vet office was fantastic! They listened, took her somewhere quiet to examine and even managed to trim her nails!  They bribed her and honestly this was the best vet visit we’ve ever had with her.  Luckily she was fine but they were so reassuring and caring towards us.  They are an amazing vet practice
We're delighted to hear about your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for your feedback.
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for choosing McGilvray Veterinary Hospital.

To continue...
July 08, 2026,
Tito feels great after the treatment!
And also, Tito is promising to Dr. John Booth and his team, to keep his teeth clean, as much as possible😊.
Many thanks to Dr Booth and his wonderful team❤️

First time going to this location with our dog, Tito.
Very impressed with the clinic welcoming atmosthere, by the professionalism and care of Dr. John Booth and his team.
Thank you! Congratiulations and keep it Up.
Happy Canada Day!🍀❤️
Signed by us and Tito

We are incredibly grateful to the entire team for the exceptional care you provided to our cat.

After visiting several clinics without seeing much improvement, we finally found your hospital. From our very first visit, we could immediately tell how professional, thorough, and clean everything was. Every member of the team treated our cat with genuine compassion and handled the wound with great care.

Our cat’s injured paw has improved tremendously under your treatment, and seeing it heal has been such a relief for our family. We truly appreciate the time you took to explain the treatment plan, answer our questions, and make sure our cat was as comfortable as possible throughout the recovery process.

Thank you for your professionalism, kindness, and dedication. We couldn’t have asked for better care, and we will absolutely recommend your clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinary team.

Thank you again for helping our cat heal!

First time going to this location with our dog, Tito. Very impressed by the clinic welcoming atmosphere, by the professionalism and care of Dr. John Booth and his team.Would highly recommend this place.

We would highly recommend McGilvray. The office is efficient and well run and the staff are friendly and helpful. We can usually get a same day appt for urgent matters with our vet Dr Marks, who is excellent. We have also seen other vets in the office who all seem extremely knowledgable and friendly.
Fantastic vet, great service, wonderful staff, and so caring with our dogs. Highly recommended.
Best vets, best clinic. The only place I would take my cat.

Awesome veterinary hospital.  All the Drs and staff at McGilvray are amazing!!

A special thank you to Dr. Lee and the staff for taking good care of our Mayah.

My friend referred me to McGilvray and I’m so grateful they did. My dog had a mast cell tumor removed there by by Dr. Daniella and Dr. Marks and the whole experience was amazing.

The doctors are very knowledgeable, professional and kind. Compared to some other vets in the city that seem more focused on making money, I can tell that the doctors here truly care about pets. I highly recommend McGilvray to anyone looking for a great veterinary clinic.

Fantastic staff and grooming services. Ringo Starr was treated for cancer there and we couldn't have felt more supported. The journey ended well for him. It is such a welcoming space and we are confident in the care Ringo receives. The groomers make sure that he looks his best.

With 4 kitties, we've been to our share of vets over the years!  Just moved to this area and took one of our kitties, Booby, for some follow up bloodwork, urinalysis and checkup for hyperthyroidism.  Dr. Lee was a great doctor and discovered she has a 1cm struvite crystal (usually dissolvable via diet).  He was more thorough than a lot of other vets we've been to, which likely led to the crystal discovery.  Very thankful.  Great clinic!
Cooper had swollen anal glands and was up all night in pain. We called in the morning for an appointment. Your technician expressed and he got relief instantly. Thank you so much

As the owner of two Scottish Fold cats, finding a veterinarian I can trust is incredibly important. McGilvray Veterinary Hospital has been wonderful to work with over the years. The team is knowledgeable, caring, and always takes the time to answer my questions and make sure my cats receive the best possible care. From routine checkups to ongoing health concerns, I've always felt confident knowing my pets are in good hands. A trusted neighbourhood veterinary clinic that I highly recommend to fellow pet owners.
McGilvray vets and team are the best! Ace and I are always received so well and Ace loves Dr John Booth (and Dr Adriana of course!) 😀🤗 …

our pet layla was under wonderful and meticulous care with mcgilvray veterinary hospital! dr daniella is absolutely incredible and her entire team of technicians, doctors and receptionists are extremely kind, helpful and supportive. every single one of our questions were answered with great detail and for the big procedure our girl went through, they made it feel very smooth and easy. we are so grateful for them! i highly recommend anyone’s pet to be in their care when needed:) thank you thank you thank you!
Dr. Fleming is amazing with Ruby and she and the technicians handle her with such care. Also, she explains everything and answers all my questions and I love that they call with test results.

Always 5 stars! The entire staff at McGilvray is experienced, and genuinely cares about the animals they treat. The clinic is spotless, appointments run on time, and the doctors explain everything clearly. Highly recommend this clinic!

I've been with McGilvray for a couple years now and have consistently felt so supported. I always know my cat is in good hands with them. Dr. Daniella Yusufov has been incredible. Shout out also to the rest of the team (techs, admin) for your help and always friendly faces
We're utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Was able to get an appointment for first visit on short notice.  Dr. Booth was very thorough, asked lots of questions and answered lots of mine. Everyone was friendly and efficient. Great care.
Thank you for sharing your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. We appreciate your feedback.
Dr. Fleming is absolutely amazing.   Her love and kindness for our little loved ones is amazing, through the good and tough times.  Thanks Dr. Fleming from Blake and Cherry.
Amazing place.
Best veterinary clinic around
Teddy is growing up happy and healthy, thanks to Dr. Darren’s exceptional care. 🐶 …
Good location, easy parking, timely, and nice waiting area. Some coffee would be lovely though while waiting for treatments
We're thrilled to hear about your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for your feedback!

Dr Jane Fleming is a very knowledgeable and compassionate vet, who has taken great care of my cat for several years.  In addition, the staff are extremely kind, patient and careful, with my cat, who is not a great patient.  I really appreciate all they have done for us.
Dr Daniela was fantastic with my dog, patient, gentle and answered all my questions.

We followed Dr. Jane Fleming from another clinic when she moved to McGilvray. Dr. Fleming is kind and friendly and relates well to us, and our Standard Poodle.  She is patient during appointments and takes the time to explain how she is  treating our dog and any recommended tests.
On occasion, if Dr. Fleming was unavailable, we have been seen by other Vets at the clinic and our dog always received excellent care.
The vibe at this clinic is friendly and positive from the time the front of clinic staff greets you, through to your departure. You can trust Dr. Fleming and the clinic with your pet.
UPDATE, we just visited Dr. Fleming at McGilvray for Ruby’s annual exam and required updated vaccinations. The usual high standards of the clinic remain the same from reception to through Ruby’s appointment with Dr. Fleming.
As an aside,  our son’s family got a new puppy, and although they visit another clinic in Vaughan, Ontario, when it came time for the puppy to be neutered, they took her to McGilvray, one of the few clinics around with a surgeon that can perform laparoscopic surgery and that has the necessary state of the art  equipment. A very positive experience and usual excellent communication.

We are so grateful to Dr. Marks and the entire team for taking such wonderful care of Woody. Leaving your dog for anesthesia and dental work is always stressful, but Dr. Marks made me feel reassured every step of the way with his professionalism, patience, and genuine compassion. We truly appreciate everything you and your team do, and we highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary team.
Fast friendly informative kind  service

Hi you-all WOW did I have a great first appointment!! Let's share some details but folks  I won't be disclosing cost due to the nature of this visit all I can say AI says it was More then reasonable and no complaints in that department. It is what is for the fantastic service and professionalism and we'll run vet clinic. So here is my Story. First advice to pet owners me I am a 20 year owner of cats.....watch you human food. There are many foods that could land your cat in an emergency status something that accidentally happened to my case likely I caught in time. I set a appointment which I couldn't keep because my cat was new to the in the cage syndrome so the Doctor cancelled without changing me and set a new appointment the next day. Make sure you check for cancellation policy. Arriving I got a room right way and saw Dr. Daniella. We discuss the case and didn't mind that I use the internet on what could be the outcome of the cats case. It's best to be open well learned and honest about your cat's symptoms. So Dr. Daniella discussed the symptoms and off she went to examine my cat. She came back and we both agreed for a full spectrum blood work to be sent to the lab called annual super Chem CBC T4 which was totally appropriate for my cats case. Dr. Daniella complimented on my cat dosile character and came back with good news about the health of my cat. So the next day the lab results will come back and will get a better idea what's going on with my cat. Symptoms were lethargic behavior not active and jumping at heights which was normal for cat. Thanks again for the great service. SF.

Had a great visit at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. I was not happy with the level of service I was receiving from my previous vet so I decided to make a change. The whole team was very helpful and friendly. You can tell they all love animals and are passionate about what they do. I have confidence that they will take great care of my pup going forward.

As always, wonderful care and attention to every detail.
And Dr. Booth was very caring and knowledgable.
Thank you to all at McGilvery!!

Dr. Marks is a wonderful, compassionate veterinarian who truly cares about his patients and provides exceptional care. I’ve been going to McGilvray for over 40 years, and the entire clinic team is consistently professional, kind, and dedicated.

Dr Adriana is the most amazing doctor she loves the animals and cares for them as they are her animals. I’ve been going to the same vet for 10 years and every 6 weeks I have to take in my golden retriever for her ear infection. It never cleared and every 6 weeks back we go. It would clear from one and then the other ear. By chance I couldn’t take her to our regular vet so we came here and met Dr Adriana. It took two visits and my dog had no more problems with her ears.  So why the difference.., well because Dr Adriana took her time and cleared her ear canal properly that when she administered the medication it actually worked.  Dr Adriana is the kindest soul I have ever met. She is gods gift to all who have been fortunate to meet her.  My dog never wanted to go to the vet. Now I tell her let’s go to Dr Adriana and she jumps in the car. Honestly Dr Adriana is the most professional and knowledgeable Dr Ive ever met. I am so lucky that we met her and her team that works with her. They truly love animals and their assistance with all shows.
We have been going to McGilvray’s for many years. They are always kind, informative and clearly care about our furry family members.
We sincerely value your five-star rating and appreciate you choosing McGilvray Veterinary Hospital for your pet's care.

I have been bringing my dogs here since 1995. They have looked after our Golden Retrievers from 8 weeks to their final days with their expertise and compassion. Now our Labrador and several Guide dog pups in training. 30 years of excellent care.
Thank you for your wonderful feedback, Darlene. We are privileged to have served you at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital.

Our three cats 🐱 🐱🐱 have been extremely well taken care of by Dr. Marks and the McGilvray team for many years.  They are compassionate, understanding, and empathetic when problems have arisen.  The team is professional, friendly, and addresses the needs of our cats in a very timely manner.  We would highly recommend the McGilvray Veterinary Hospital.
We are utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital. Thank you immensely for your kind words.
Fast and friendly. A bit pricey for a relatively quick easy treatment.

Dr Lee was great. He quickly diagnosed and offered treatment for our cat, and followed up the next day with lab results and to check how she was after her injection at the clinic. He also offered further treatment if needed.
Very good service and great with are animals. Would highly recommend this veterinarian hospital. Alway a pleasure
We're honored to have received your positive review, Gordon. Thank you for your feedback.
Excellent as always, attentive to our pet's needs and our concerns. Highly recommended McGilvray!

I love the staff here. They are very friendly and love the animals.
Doctors are great and take the time to listen.
Great Veterinary.
Your positive experience at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Dr. Marks is an excellent vet- we thoroughly appreciate his skill, knowledge and compassion. We have been clients at this clinic for over 30 years with 3 dogs and 4 cats.
Dr Marks is the absolute best. We are so grateful he takes such great care of our little Leo.  Everyone there is so attentive and wonderful.
Very happy with my first encounter and feel confident to have Ruby under Dr. Daniella's care. We now have a plan to address Ruby's ongoing issue without jumping to conclusions.
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Lee and the entire team at McGilvray Veterinary Hospital! From the moment we walked through the door, we were welcomed with such kindness and warmth. The staff are incredibly sweet, friendly, and genuinely care about both the animals and their owners, which makes such a difference.

Dr. Lee is absolutely outstanding. He is not only extremely knowledgeable and professional, but also so kind, patient, and compassionate. He took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answer all of our questions, and made us feel completely comfortable and confident in the care our dog Carl receives.

We are so grateful to Dr. Lee and the entire team for the amazing care and support. I would highly recommend McGilvray Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary clinic with knowledgeable, compassionate staff who truly go the extra mile!
